2.o: Richard I'Anson documents a fire rite, attempts to photograph the elusive Himalayan snow leopard and captures the colorful Festival of Holi.

3.o: Intrepid adventure sports photographer Krystle Wright crafts images of free divers in Vanuatu, highliners in Colorado and paragliders in Utah.

4.o: From brown bears in the rivers of Alaska to mountain gorillas in the jungles of Uganda, nature photographer Art Wolfe hunts for the perfect picture.

5.o: Following in the footsteps of explorer Ernest Shackleton, landscape photographer Peter Eastway travels to Antarctica to create stunning polar images.

6.o: Art Wolfe documents the world's cultures, including the Surma of Ethiopia and the masked mud men and Huli clans of Papua, New Guinea.

1.o: Hoping to ensure the park's survival, wildlife photographers Jonathan and Angela Scott document the native creatures of the Maasai Mara in Kenya.

2.t: Believe - I Will Always Be Here

4.t: Run - When the Mind Is Full

The years pass and the tragedy of Shams with her niece is repeated.

In an effort to end many years of tyrannical rule, five pilots and their Gundams are dispatched to Earth to begin Operation Meteor. Four land without incident, but one is intercepted and his mission is compromised.

2.o: Heero plans to destroy the Wing Gundam before it is discovered by the Alliance forces. Heero gets his hands on two torpedoes and attempts to destroy his Gundam. Relena, refusing to believe Heero's threat, tries to confront him but is interrupted by the arrival of Duo Maxwell...

3.o: Heero is injured and is kept for treatment at the Alliance hospital. At the Corsican base of the Mediterranean, the Gundam Heavyarms, piloted by L3's Trowa Barton, annihilates everything in its path. Then things get even worse for the Alliance when the Gundam Sandrock shows up.

4.o: L5's Wufei Chang, in his Shenlong Gundam, attacks the Taurus MS's transports after coming into Lake Victoria base late at night. Lucrezia Noin, head instructor at the base and good friend of Zechs Merquise, tries to fight him off in her Aries MS.

5.o: Relena and her father, Vice Foreign Minister Darlian, journey to the colonies to try and prevent war. but there are those who do not want peace. Amidst the grief and tragedy, Relena learns her true identity...

6.o: Relena goes back to Earth. Wufei attacks another Alliance base and Trowa has started to work in a circus as a cover. Back at school, Relena tells Heero that she knows everything about him and invites him to a party, to be held that night.

7.o: Treize Kushrenada's plans to destroy the Alliance come to a head when the leaders of the Alliance hold a meeting. The meeting is led by Marshal Noventa and outlines his peace agenda. However, based on Treize's false intelligence, the Gundams destroy the Alliance leadership, and Oz begins to take over Earth.

8.o: Lady Une makes the Gundams her next target and activates the self-destruct sequence on the New Edwards Base. Can Heero prevent the explosion of the New Edwards Base and find the person who set them up? Meanwhile, Wufei duels with Treize.

9.o: The United Earth Sphere Alliance collapses, sending the entire Planet into a panic. This allows OZ to step forward and take control through a well planned coup. Zechs is occupied with other things: he is searching for the ruins of the Sanc Kingdom.

10.o: Lady Une briefs her troops on another strategy to try and wipe out the Gundams. Heero and Zechs face each other again, but this time it's the Wing Gundam versus the Tallgeese.

11.o: The Gundams have been defeated. With the colonies used as shields, the pilots don't have a chance. No one knows whether Heero is dead or alive. On the trail of her father's killer, Relena heads to Moscow. Duo and Quatre take refuge with the Maguanac Corps.

12.o: The Gundams must fight to regain peace. Wufei meets Sally Po on the battlefield and tells her that the weak should not be fighting. Still, lost in his emotion, Wufei once again gets into his Shenlong Gundam.

13.o: Two misguided OZ soldiers are going on an execution spree, destroying any remaining Alliance resistance. In an effort to save the colonies, Trowa heads for his final battle. However, Catherine stands between him and his death wish...

14.o: To try and make up for his mistake of killing the honorable pacifist leader Noventa, Heero confronts his granddaughter, Sylvia Noventa. Meanwhile, Zechs is handed an order from the Romefeller Foundation...

15.o: Zechs' warrior nature craves a decisive battle. Noin invites Heero to Antarctica, where Zechs awaits. Suspecting that Zechs has violated the order to destroy Zero One, the Romefeller Foundation sends troops after him.

16.o: At the South Pole, Zechs waits with the newly-rebuilt Wing Gundam. After Herro arrives and the rematch begins, Relena arrives and tries to stop them from wasting their lives. However, she discovers a revelation...

17.o: OZ sets in motion its plans to destroy the Alliance military once and for all. Quatre and Duo head to outer space to warn the colonies of the impending danger, only to discover they've been declared the enemy.

18.o: The fight between the Tallgeese and the Gundams conclude. Now, Zechs refuses to fight for, and ends his affiliation with the Romefeller Foundation.

19.o: The Gundam Deathscythe single-handedly battles OZ's Mobile Suits in space, and Duo ends up getting captured. Heero searches for Duo in order to silence him...

20.o: OZ is developing 2 new Mobile Suits that can challenge the Gundams. Heero accepts the mission to sneak in and sabotage their operations. But he is unprepared for who he meets while inside the base...

21.o: A wild Mobile Suit approaches the colonies at high speed; Lady Une orders test pilots Heero and Trowa to stop it. Meanwhile, Quatre, exhausted from the pressure of his missions, returns home for a visit. But what he finds there is not comfort, only more chaos and tragedy.

22.o: The colonies have begun arming themselves for the coming fight against OZ. However, more surprising than that is the switch in Lady Une-she's become an advocate for peace. She is now acting on Treize's behalf without the consent of the Romefeller Foundation.

23.t: Duo, the Great Destroyer Once Again
23.o: With Lady Une's help, Duo escapes from OZ and goes to destroy the Mobile Suit production base on the moon. But while there, he meets a girl named Hilde who has become a soldier. The choice is suddenly much more complicated.

24.o: A Mobile Suit with fantastic power is on a rampage. It's attacking the colonies one after another in a brutal display of raw power. Trowa and Heero move to intercept this strange new Mobile Suit and are surprised by who its pilot is...

25.o: Trowa and Heero must battle their crazed friend; but they find themselves losing against this new Gundam. Treize, meanwhile, disapproves of the Romefeller Foundation's plan to use Mobile Dolls-automated Mobile Suits without pilots. His dissension results in his arrest by OZ.

26.t: The Eternal Flame of the Shooting Stars
26.o: Treize is freed by OZ soldiers loyal to him, but the trouble is only beginning. Romefeller is out to eliminate the Gundams and Treize, since they are symbols of hipe. Operation NOVA commences, and all of the Earth is in danger.

27.t: The Locus of Victory and Defeat
27.o: Relena, thinking back on past events, becomes determined to put an end to the Romefeller Foundation's tyranny.

28.o: Treize, while not in the middle of the battlefield, continues to scheme.

29.o: Romefeller is gaining ground on Earth very quickly and Treize and his troops seem to be losing the battle. When Heero realizes that Treize is now fighting Romefeller, he joins his army as a mercenary and finds himself working alongside Sally Po and Lucrezia Noin.

30.o: Quatre isn't convinced that Heero's mercenary path is the correct one. However, having witnessed the horrors of war, he cannot stand by and do nothing. When Relena declares the Sanc Kingdom's neutrality, Quatre and Heero take refuge.

31.o: Heero and Quatre decide to stay in the Sanc Kingdom and help Relena promote pacifism. But when the Romefeller Foundation attacks, Heero, Quatre and Noin go into battle.

32.o: Still in space, Duo has been retaliating against OZ. But OZ closes in, and Duo and his incomplete Gundam Deathscythe Hell must fight the Wing Zero.

33.o: Zechs steps onto the battlefield once again and attacks Romefeller's forces. Meanwhile, Heero heads off to help the Treize Faction.

34.o: Zechs gets the Wing Gundam Zero and demolishes the OZ forces. However, Treize gives Heero a new Gundam, perhaps the most terrible Gundam of all, and its name is Epyon...

35.o: Wanting to join the Gundam pilots in their fight, Zechs goes to meet Wufei, But Wufei, pilot of the new Altron Gundam, believes him to be the enemy.

36.o: Duo and Trowa are reunited and team up against the enemy once more. Meanwhile, the Romefeller Foundation has mounted a final assault against the Sanc Kingdom, forcing Relena to surrender to prevent a battle.

37.o: Relena, now a prisoner of the Romefeller Foundation, is faced with a very difficult choice. Meanwhile Heero and Zechs engage in battle once again-this time on the grounds of the Sanc Kingdom.

38.o: A group of rebel colony citizens calling themselves the "White Fang" starts attacking OZ bases. Quatre and Noin search for the other Gundam pilots. The Romefeller Foundation names Queen Relena as their representative.

39.o: Quinze, the leader of the White Fang, contacts Zechs and asks him-and his Gundam-to join their cause. Still suffering from amnesia, Trowa once agian goes into battle.

40.o: As Relena takes her first step towards trying to achieve true peace, Heero sets out to eliminate her. Milliardo Peacecraft, the new leader of the White Fang, is now intent on going to war against OZ, the Romefeller Foundation and the Gundam pilots.

41.o: With Milliardo Peacecraft's declaration of war against the Earth in effect, the battle rages on between the White Fang and OZ. Meanwhile, Treize returns to take control of the Romefeller Foundation, forcing Relena to step down. In space, the Gundam pilots encounter Milliardo and his Epyon.

1.o: Jeong Yoojin is your regular "Little Miss Tardy" who too often finds herself in trouble for her lateness. Today seems no different and once again it is another rush to school for Yoojin with her childhood friend; Kim Sanghyeok. Unbeknownst to her, this day is different. Fate intervenes as she makes the acquaintance of a mysterious new student.

2.o: Kang Joonsang and Yoojin's love begins to blossom as they keep on running into each other. In the meantime, Joonsang becomes confused and shocked to find the same picture he has at Yoojin's house.

3.o: Yoojin waits for Joonsang until late at night, but he never appears. The next day, she hears the shocking news that Joonsang was killed in a car accident. Ten years later, Yoojin is engaged to Sanghyeok. She meets her friend Oh Chaerin's boyfriend Lee Minhyeong, who looks just like Joonsang.

4.o: Yoojin and Minhyeong work together in renovating a ski resort. Although Yoojin tries to hide that she's working with Minhyeong, Sanghyeok soon finds out.

5.o: Sanghyeok is unhappy that Yoojin is working with Minhyeong but realizes that he cannot make her quit the work. When Chaerin finds out that Yoojin and her boyfriend work together, she feels threatened and makes up lies about her to Minhyeong.

6.o: Minhyeong takes the drunk Yoojin to his hotel room and is surprised when she calls him "Joonsang". The misunderstanding between the two deepens and Chaerin sets fire to Minhyeong's anger towards Yoojin.

7.o: Yoojin is injured while trying to save Minhyeong, and her boyfriend Sanghyeok is infuriated. When Minhyeong realizes that his girlfriend Chaerin lied to him about Yoojin, he asks her for some space in their relationship. Minhyeong and Yoojin go together to a pond where she shared beautiful memories with Joonsang when they were in high school.

8.o: Minhyeong and Yoojin spend the night at the ski resort and Sanghyeok and Chaerin wait for them anxiously. The next morning, Sanghyeok questions Yoojin whether she truly loves him. When she is unable to answer him, Sanghyeok coldly turns away from her.

9.o: Yoojin tells Sanghyeok that she cannot marry him, and at the same time, she assures Minhyeong that she cannot have a relationship with him. She begs Sanghyeok to give her a chance to stand on her own. Sanghyeok does everything he can to change her mind, while stepping up to Minhyeong and warning him to not shake her heart.

10.o: Yoojin finally breaks up with Sanghyeok when she realizes that she is completely in love with Minhyeong. Although everybody around her opposes her love, she tells herself that she can be happy as long as she is with Minhyeong. Meanwhile, Sanghyeok refuses to eat or sleep.

11.o: Yoojin tells Sanghyeok about Minhyeong’s mother. Sanghyeok goes to the high school to see student records.

12.o: Minhyeong goes to Joonsang's old house and meets Kang Mihee. Mihee assures him that Minhyeong is actually Joonsang. Sanghyeok calls Minhyeong as Joonsang and warns him to stay away from Yoojin. Meanwhile, Minhyeong takes Yoojin to his car by force, and tells her that he is Joonsang. Unable to believe his words, Yoojin only looks into his eyes with sad tears.

13.o: Despite Minhyeong's confession that he is Joonsang, Yoojin does not believe him, thinking that he is only doing that to get her back. Meanwhile, seeing Yoojin even in his missing pieces of memories, Minhyeong sadly sheds tears. Minhyeong decides to leave as he realizes that as long as he cannot fully remember his past, he can no longer linger around Yoojin.

14.o: When Yoojin finds out that Minhyeong is Joonsang, she desperately runs out to find him and stop him from leaving. During her attempt, she nearly gets into a car accident, and Minhyeong jumps in and gets hurt instead.

15.o: Joonsang recovers his lost memories partially and shares them with Yoojin. Although Yoojin and Joonsang spend a happy time together for the first time in ten years, they both have heavy hearts as they are unable to erase the pain, they have caused their friends.

16.o: Joonsang and Yoojin finally make up with their friend. One day, Joonsang realizes that the last missing piece of his memories concerns his father. Meanwhile, when Professor Kim Jinwoo hears that Minhyeong is Joonsang, he cannot help but question whether Joonsang is his long-lost son.

18.o: Unable to change Yoojin's mother's mind, Yoojin and Joonsang decide to have a secret wedding by themselves. However, their plan is shattered when Sanghyeok chases after them.

19.o: Yoojin discovers a shocking secret from Mihee. Meanwhile, Joonsang treats Yoojin coldly, knowing that he should cut ties with her. Realizing how difficult it must be for him, Yoojin suggests to Joonsang that they go their separate ways.

1.o: تغادر فتاة شابة كوكبها الأم لتنطلق في مغامرة أسطورية تبدأ في قلب السلالة التي تحكم المجرّة بقبضة من حديد والمعروفة باسم "الإمبراطورية".

2.o: تقطع جماعة الأساس رحلة طويلة إلى "ترمنوس" بينما تتوطد علاقة "غايل" بـ"ريش". وتواجه الإمبراطورية قراراً صعباً.

3.o: يتفكر الأخ "داسك" في إرثه بينما يتجهز لزواله. تصل جماعة الأساس إلى "ترمنوس" وتجد جسماً غامضاً.

4.o: تواجه "سالفور" أحد أعداء الإمبراطورية. وينشب خلاف بين الأخوين "داي" و"داسك"، بينما يغالب الأخ "دون" حقيقته.

5.o: تكشف مشاهد من الماضي أصل حيرة "غايل" بين الإيمان والعلم. ومواجهة على "ترمنوس" تأخذ منعطفاً مؤسفاً.

6.o: الأخ "داي" يقابل "زيفر هاليما"، القائدة المحتملة التي تعارض الإمبراطورية. والأخ "داسك" يعتريه الشك في الأخ "دون".

7.o: يصعد الأناكريونيون ورهائنهم على متن سفينة "إنفكتس" الحربية الأسطورية. وتقوى العلاقة بين الأخ "دون" و"أزورا".

8.o: يشرع الأخ "داي" في رحلة لم يقطعها أي "كليون" من قبله قط. و"سالفور" تستعد لتقديم التضحية الكبرى كي ترجع إلى الوطن.

9.o: على "ترمنوس"، تشتد قوة الحقل الفارغ. والأخ "دون" يتخذ قراراً جريئاً.

10.o: حليف غير متوقع يساعد "سالفور" على إقامة تحالف. ومواجهة بين الإخوة الثلاثة تؤدي إلى عواقب مستحيلة.

1.o: "هاري" يجد نفسه حبيساً داخل سجن غامض. ومحاولة اغتيال تزعزع "داي". و"غايل" و"سالفور" يضعان خطة هروب.

2.o: رؤيا مزعجة تراود "غايل". وتوطيد الرابط بين "داي" والملكة "سارث". والخزانة تنفتح وتفصح عن رسالة مبهمة.

3.o: الإمبراطورية تجنّد "بل ريوس" للتحقيق في جماعة الأساس المتمردة. و"هاري" يقود "غايل" و"سالفور" إلى كوكب صحراوي.

4.t: Where the Stars Are Scattered Thinly
4.o: الملكة "سارث" و"دون" يتشاركان لحظة حميمة عندما تحاول اكتشاف المزيد عن "داي". والأخوان "كونستانت" و"بولي" يحضران "هوبر مالو" إلى "ترمنوس".

5.o: "غايل" و"سالفور" و"هاري" يصلون إلى "إغنس" ويلتقون مصدر الإشارة الغريبة التي كانوا يتعقّبونها. و"دون" و"داسك" يرتابان في "داي".

6.o: "داي" والملكة "سارث" يعلنان خبراً. و"تيلم" تزرع بذور الشك بين "غايل" و"هاري". و"هوبر مالو" يبلغ وجهته.

7.o: "سالفور" تشرع تشكّك في دوافع الـ"منتالكيين". واقتراح "هوبر مالو" على مرتادي الفضاء يُقابل بالرفض. والأخوان "كونستانت" و"بولي" يمثلان أمام محكمة.

8.o: الآمرة "رو" تأتمن "داي" على شكوكها في "ديمرزل". و"هوبر مالو" ينفذ خطوة جريئة. و"داي" ينطلق نحو "ترمنوس" وجماعة الأساس.

9.ar: منذ زمن بعيد، ومسافة غير بعيدة
9.o: "داسك" والآمرة "رو" يكتشفان أصول "ديمرزل" وغرضها الحقيقي. وخطط "تيلم" بخصوص "غايل" تأخذ منحنى خبيثاً. وعلى "ترمنوس"، "داي" يواجه الدكتور "سلدون".

10.o: "غايل" و"سالفور" و"هاري" يرسمون خارطة طريق جديدة على "إغنس". و"ديمرزل" تتوجه صوب "ترانتور"، متخذةً أفعالاً ستغيّر الإمبراطورية إلى الأبد.

1.t: A Song for the End of Everything
1.o: قرصان جديد مجهول ذو قوى مرعبة، يُعرف باسم "ذا ميول"، يلفت انتباه جماعة الأساس والإمبراطورية.

2.o: "غايل" و"هاري" يحققان تقدماً في خططهما في "إغنس". والإمبراطورية تبتّ في أمر تنبّؤ مفاجئ. و"بريتشر" يطلب المساعدة لتحرّي "ذا ميول".

3.o: تشكيل تحالف غير متوقع. و"بريتشر" و"بايتا" و"توران" يلاقون "ذا ميول" وجهاً إلى وجه. و"ديمرزل" تطلب الإرشاد الروحي.

4.o: "ديمرزل" تصارع مفارقة برمجتها. وانكشاف ولاء "بريتشر" الحقيقي. و"داي" ينطلق ساعياً إلى البحث عن أجوبة.

5.o: "داي" يدخل أرضاً مجهولة. و"دون" و"غايل" يطبّقان خطّتهما. وقيمة "ماغنيفيكو" تتجلّى. و"ديمرزل" تحاول استعادة السطوة.

6.o: العنف يضرب في اجتماع شمل طال انتظاره. وفي "نيو ترمنوس"، الخزانة تنفتح، و"ذا ميول" يصوّب سلاحه.

7.o: وابل من الفوضى والدمار يسقط على "نيو ترمنوس". وفي "ترانتور"، "داسك" و"كوينت" يتّحدان لتقييم حالة المجرّة.

8.o: "غايل" وجماعة الأساس الثانية يواجهون توابع سقوط "نيو ترمنوس". و"داي" يواجه الحكم في "مايكوجن". وارتقاء "داسك" يلوح في الأفق.

9.o: "غايل" تواجه قوة تحويلات "ذا ميول". و"داسك" يلجأ إلى إجراءات متطرفة. و"ديمرزل" تبحث عن أجوبة حول المستقبل.

10.o: "غايل" وجماعة الأساس الثانية ينقلون ساحة القتال عند "ذا ميول"، بينما يتلقّى إرث الإمبراطورية ضربة كارثية.

1.o: In the summer before their final year at Trinity College, Frances and her best friend Bobbi meet an impressive local writer, Melissa. Bobbi quickly develops a crush on Melissa but Frances is unexpectedly drawn to Melissa’s husband, Nick.

2.o: At Melissa’s birthday party, Frances finds herself alone with Nick. They can’t resist the attraction between them and kiss. The next day Frances visits her parents in the country and agonises over what this turn of events might mean.

3.o: Back in Dublin, Frances and Nick meet to discuss the kiss. Their attraction deepens and they begin an affair. Things become complicated when Nick travels to Scotland for work. Frances is unable to confide in Bobbi and their relationship also suffers.

4.o: Frances and Bobbi travel to Croatia to join Melissa and Nick on holiday. Having not seen or spoken to Nick in a few weeks, Frances learns that he has had a tough time recently and they both realise that they are still attracted to each other.

5.o: As Frances and Nick grow closer things become tense between Bobbi and Frances. Bobbi can sense Nick’s attraction to Frances and becomes frustrated with Frances’s reluctance to talk about it. A visit from Melissa’s agent raises tensions in the villa.

6.o: Back in Ireland, tensions remain unresolved with Bobbi.  Frances visits her mother but ends up in hospital when she has an attack of severe abdominal pain. Before returning to Dublin, she visits her father and is confronted by his growing alcoholism.

7.o: As final year at Trinity begins, Bobbi reveals she is looking for a room to rent and Frances asks her to move in. Nick returns from Croatia. He and Frances contemplate being more open about their relationship – which excites and frightens her.

8.o: At Melissa’s book launch Frances struggles with her growing feelings for Nick. Her jealousy frustrates Bobbi. Feeling alone, Frances seeks intimacy elsewhere but the reality of her feelings for Nick cause her to behave in a destructive way.

9.o: Frances writes her first short story. Her health is still causing her problems and she collapses at college. Bobbi brings her home and as Frances recovers they talk more honestly about their friendship. Nick makes a surprising revelation.

10.o: Frances receives a surprise email from Melissa and the groups’ dynamics are tested in unsuspected ways. Frances’ dad leaves a concerning voicemail and Bobbi also has problems with her family; she and Frances experience a shift in their friendship.

11.o: Frances sees a consultant and is given a diagnosis that distresses her. This news, combined with an upsetting revelation from Nick and an unexpected argument with Bobbi, causes Frances’ life to spiral out of control.

12.o: Frances faces up to the consequences of her actions and attempts to repair her relationship with Bobbi. She also finds a fragile understanding with her parents. But as she strives to take control of her life, the question of her and Nick remains.

1.o: Since Da-jung was diagnosed with cancer, Chang-wook, her husband, has been in charge of cooking. Their son, Jae-ho, is a senior in high school, and he is waiting for the results of his college admission to come out. Chang-wook cooks japchae for his family today.

2.t: The Miracle of Space Warp, Dombe Noodles
2.o: Chang-wook makes dombe noodles for Da-jung. Da-jung is having a hard time trying to remember the beach on Jeju Island she went to with Jae-ho and her sister Da-sol about five years ago but refuses to look it up on the internet. Jae-ho asks Da-jung to get him a studio as a present so that he can live alone once he enters college.

3.o: Chang-wook’s students give him a set of gulbi as a year-end present. Jae-ho learns about Da-jung’s illness. Jae-ho doesn’t go to school and ignores Yeo-jin’s texts and phone calls because he’s disturbed by Da-jung’s condition, and Yeo-jin, who knows nothing about it, is upset.

4.t: Rice Cake Soup on New Year's Day We Long For
4.o: Finally, the first edition of Hye-young’s new book is out, so Da-jung delivers it to Hye-young herself. Da-jung tells Min-young to think about taking over her publishing house. Chang-wook makes rice cake soup on New Year’s Day.

5.t: We All Need Some Sweet Consolation
5.o: Jae-ho feels helpless regarding Da-jung's illness, so he even audits a class at the medical school and looks up home remedies on the internet. Da-jung visits a woodland burial site by herself to see what it looks like. Da-jung tells Chang-wook to sleep in her bed together.

6.o: Chang-wook buys a Chinese wok and knife and learns the special tangsuyuk recipe to make it properly for Da-jung. Yeo-jin is upset because Jae-ho doesn't understand the frustration she feels as a repeater. Da-jung collapses in severe pain and is taken to the ER.

7.o: Da-jung is administered to the hospital and not able to eat much food. As Da-jung says she wants to drink mango juice, Chang-wook makes various types of fruit juices for her. But the doctor says her condition is so serious that immediate surgery might not be possible.

8.t: An Amazing Effect of No-Antibiotic Thinly-Sliced Pork Belly
8.o: Da-jung refuses to get surgery. But after a week of Chang-wook’s persuasion, Da-jung decides to get surgery. The surgery, which was expected to take longer than three hours, ends just in one and a half hours, making Chang-wook and Jae-ho worried.

9.o: Da-jung can eat food after the surgery, but she is still in pain as cancer has spread through her body. Chang-wook feels grateful that she can eat at least and tries his best to take care of her. To share the burden, the aunt in Sweden and Da-sol come to Korea, and Chang-wook cooks food to treat his wife’s family. And Da-sol and Hye-young are surprised to see that Chang-wook’s cooking skills have significantly improved.

10.o: Da-jung and Chang-wook start to dispose of Da-jung’s stuff as she is about to be admitted to a care center. Meanwhile, Da-jung’s condition gets worse. As she has almost no appetite, Chang-wook tries to develop a new recipe. The day before Da-jung is admitted, Chang-wook politely declines to sell Da-jung’s car as he is not ready to send her away yet.

11.o: The doctor tells Da-jung she can drink liquids that aren’t water, so Chang-wook makes fruit juice for Da-jung and filters it multiple times to eliminate all fiber. Da-jung compares the bland but tasty juice to Chang-wook and teaches him how to make his favorite kimchi rice.

12.t: Is This What That Was For?
12.o: Chang-wook and everyone bids their final farewell to Da-jung and find their way back to their lives without her presence. Chang-wook finds a way to get closure and come to terms with Da-jung’s absence by doing the last homework Da-jung has left him.

1.o: تطلب ثريا من أحمد حضور عيد ميلاد زوجة عمه فيرفض، ويطلب أحمد رفع الحصانة عن النائب شادي العزبي بعد اتهامه في قضية استيراد طعام فاسد وتسمم العديد بسببه.

2.o: ينفعل شهاب على ابنته بسبب تغيبها عن المنزل، ويطلب شادي من نجلته سلوى التعرف على نجلة رئيس النيابة مها لكي تتدخل وتُقنع والدها بالابتعاد عنه.

3.o: تُكلف إحسان - أحمد بالبحث عن زوجها المُتغيب، ويعثر عليه مقتولًا بشقته في الزمالك، وتحقق الشرطة بالقضية.

4.o: يكتشف شهاب استغلال زوجته وتوماس لأطفال أفارقة وبيع أعضائهم مقابل المال، ويطلب شادي من نجلته تقديم هدية قيمة لمها.

5.o: تطلب ثريا من المدرسين إعطاء مجموعات تقوية مجانية للطلبة، وتعرض سلوى هدية على مها فترفض الأخيرة، وتتدهور حالة مها الصحية.

6.o: يطلب أحمد من عمته مبلغ كبير من المال لإجراء عملية بالقلب لمها خارج البلاد، وتشترط عمته كتابته وصلة أمانة بالمبلغ، وينجح شهاب في إجراء الجراحة لمها.

7.o: يُقيم شهاب مؤتمرًا صحفيًا للإعلان عن عملية مها ونجاحه المُبهر في إجراء العملية بطريقة جديدة، وتتعرض سارة لحادث خلال قيادة سيارتها تحت تأثير الكحول.

8.o: يحصل شادي على حكمًا بالبراءة في قضيته، ويطعن أحمد على الحكم فيقبل القاضي، وتتفق مارجريت وتوماس على التخلص من شهاب.

9.o: يتفق توماس مع مارجريت على الاستمرار في إعطاء عقاقير الهلوسة لزوجها شهاب حتى يُنفذ المخطط بالتخلص منه، ويُخبر توماس أهل السيناتور المتوفي بتسبب شهاب في وفاته.

10.o: تشهد كبيرة الممرضات ضد شهاب في التحقيق بوفاة السيناتور، وتستمر مارجريت في وضع عقار الهلوسة لزوجها شهاب، ويُحكم على شهاب بعدم ممارسة الطب مرة أخرى ودفع غرامة مالية لأهل المتوفي.

11.o: تعاتب عمة أحمد الأخير على وقوفه ضد النائب شادي العزبي وتطلب منه تولي إدارة شركاتها الخاصة فيرفض، ويُعجب ماهر بصديقته في الجامعة.

12.o: يُدبر شادي خطة للإيقاع بأحمد، وينجح في تخدير الأخير وتوريطه في قضية آداب، ويحاول حارس العقار تبرئة أحمد من القضية.

13.o: يتتبع المحامي العام مسار قضية أحمد ويصل للجناة ويأمر بالقبض على دلال التي بدورها تعترف على شادي، ويواجه المحامي العام شادي بدلال التي دبرت الخطة كاملة.

14.o: يكتشف شهاب خطة زوجته مارجريت مع عشيقها توماس للإيقاع به ويستمع إلى التسجيلات الخاصة بهما، وتتخلص مارجريت من الأدلة التي تُدينها وتتهم شهاب أمام الشرطة بمحاولة الاعتداء عليها وفقدانه لصوابه.

15.o: تحاول جين إقناع شهاب بالتخلي عن فكرة إخبار الأطباء بمحاولة زوجته التخلص منه على أمل الخروج من المصحة، ويُدبر شادي خطة لقتل أحمد ولكنه يفشل مرة أخرى ويموت السائق الخاص بأحمد.

16.o: يُعاتب شادي - عنتر على فشل خطة قتل أحمد ولكن الأخير يعده بتدبير خطة أخرى للنيل من أحمد، ويخرج شهاب من المصحة النفسية وينزعج توماس ومارجريت من خروجه.

17.o: يحصل أحمد على تعويض مادي بقضيته مع شادي ويتبرع به لضحايا الحادث الذي تسبب فيه الأخير، ويعود شهاب إلى مصر ويُقابل أحمد وتبدأ رحلة الصداقة بينهما.

18.o: تمرض عمة أحمد بعد رؤيتها لشهاب، ويحكي شهاب تفاصيل ما حدث له في إنجلترا وخيانة زوجته له مع صديقها وعشيقها توماس.

19.o: يحاول شهاب الإصلاح بين أحمد وعمته، ويتبرع شهاب لأحمد بالدم بعد تعرض الأخير لمحاولة قتل على يد عنتر.

20.o: يحكم القاضي بالسجن المؤبد على شادي العزبي، ويتشاجر نبيل مع عمرو ويدفع الأخير سها ناحية السيارة فتُصاب إصابة بالغة، ويُخبر أحمد شهاب بما حدث لنجلته سها.

21.o: يكتشف شهاب وجود مشاكل في القلب لدى عمة أحمد - إحسان، وتُنقل ثريا من المدرسة التي كانت تترأس منصب مديرتها إلى إدارة اخرى بعد علم الوزارة بموضوع نجلتها سها.

22.o: يحصل شهاب على وصل الأمانة الخاص بصديقه أحمد من إحسان ويُخبرها ألا تُخبر أحمد بحصوله على الوصل، وتكتشف مارجريت خيانة توماس لها مع نجلتها سارة، ويتعرض ماهر لحادثة سير.

23.o: يتوفى ماهر نجل شهاب، ويُحقق أحمد في قضية قتل شخص لخاله ويجمع الأدلة والبراهين، وتتدهور حالة إحسان فيأتي شهاب ويُخبر أحمد بوفاتها.

24.o: يضطر أحمد لترك منزله ويذهب للعيش في قصر عمته بعد وفاتها، ويطلب من شهاب تولي مسئولية إدارة المستشفى، وتتوطد العلاقة بين شهاب ومها.

25.o: يذهب شهاب إلى مكتب أحمد في النيابة ويُخبره برغبته في التقدم ببلاغ، ويُصدم أحمد حينما يكتشف اتهام شهاب له بقتل عمته إحسان.

26.o: يُخبر شهاب - أحمد بقدرته على التراجع عن تقديم بلاغ ضده بقتل عمته، مقابل السفر وقتل مارجريت وتوماس فيرفض أحمد تنفيذ الأمر.

27.o: تتهم سارة - مارجريت بتسببها في وفاة ماهر، وتطلب سارة من توماس الزواج، ويحاول أحمد إنكار قتله لعمته أمام شهاب دون جدوى.

28.o: ينفعل أحمد على نبيل بعد اكتشافه بتسبب الأخير في حادث سها، ويطلب المدعي العام يد مها فترفض.

29.o: تأتي جين لزيارة شهاب فتغضب مها بسبب حبها له، وتُخبر سها والدتها بمشاعر مها تجاه شهاب.

30.o: يطلب شهاب يد مها، وينفعل أحمد عليه فيهدده شهاب مجددًا بفتح قضية قتله لعمته.

31.o: يوافق أحمد على شرط شهاب بقتل زوجته مارجريت وعشيقها توماس بشرط الابتعاد عن مها، ويُقدم أحمد استقالته ويقبلها النائب العام.

32.o: يبتعد شهاب رويدًا رويدًا عن مها ويتهرب منها، ويُخبر أحمد زوجته بسفره إلى إنجلترا، ويُقابل أحمد - زوجة شهاب ويحاول إقناعها برد الحقوق لشهاب فترفض.

33.o: تغضب مارجريت من توماس بعد اكتشافها رغبة سارة بالزواج منه، وتكتشف مارجريت سرقة توماس لأعضاء نجلها ماهر بعد وفاته فيقتلها توماس، ويعترف شهاب لأحمد بتدبيره لقتل إحسان.

1.o: في ظل تبقّي أيام معدودة، يعلن فريق "كويك ستيب ألفا فينيل" عن قائمة المشاركين، ويقيّم العقبات التي قد تواجهه. فهل يستطيع "فابيو جاكوبسن" العودة إلى سابق عهده؟

2.o: ينطلق فريق "جامبو فيسما" بمتسابقيه الشرسين على الطرق المرصوفة بالأحجار… لكن التحديات الميكانيكية والمنافسة الداخلية تمهد الطريق للفوضى.

3.o: مع مرور ثلث السباق دون فوز لـ"فرنسا"، يدخل فريقا "غروباما إف دي جاي" و"إيه جي 2 آر سيتروين" المرحلة الجبلية، فيما تتابعهم أعين الجماهير.

4.o: أثناء مرحلة "غرانون"، ينافس "يوناس" للظفر بالقميص الأصفر… ولكن عندما يعترض طريقه سلوفيني سريع، يغيّر فريق "جامبو فيسما" خطته الهجومية.

5.o: بينما يستعرض فريق "إي إف إديوكيشن إيزيبوست" مواهبه الشابة بشكل استراتيجي، يفكّر فريق "إنيوس غريناديرز" في استخدام سلاحه السري المتمثل في الوافد الجديد "توماس بيدكوك".

6.o: بعد انسحاب قائدهم من السباق، يخاطر فريق "ألبيسين ديكونينك" بالمراهنة على "جاسبر فيليبسن" الملقب بـ"الكارثة"… فهل يصبح اسمًا على مسمّى أم سيثبت جدارته؟

7.o: يبدأ الأسبوع الأخير من السباق. وفي ظل المخاطر المحيطة بإرث "غيرانت توماس" الفائز في 2018، ينطلق لمنافسة "ديفيد غودو"، قائد فريق "غروباما إف دي جاي"، للوصول إلى منصة التتويج.

8.o: لا يفصل بين درّاجي التسارع والوصول إلى "باريس" سوى دفعة أخيرة وسط الجبال. وبينما يبذل "فابيو" قصارى جهده، يخوض "يوناس" و"فاوت" المعركة ضد "تاديه بوغاتشار" حتى النهاية.

1.o: Due to the release of a new product, Jae-won stays in the office by herself till late at night when her longtime stalker barges into the office, trying to attack her. Later, Jae-won finds out the stalker’s identity. Nam Tae-ju, an insurance investigator, tells Jae-won that they’re suspecting Jae-won’s stepfather for her mother’s death. Meanwhile, Jae-won sees a suspicious message on her husband’s phone, only to find out later that he is cheating on her.

2.o: Jae-won wakes up at the hospital after the incident. Because her company is launching a new product soon and she doesn’t know who the attacker is, she decides to let it go for now. But since she can’t trust the people around her, she asks Tae-ju to look into them. She feels sorry for suspecting her father, but regarding her husband, she becomes more certain about him having an affair.

3.o: Teo tells Yoon-jin that he saw her with Soon-young and that she should stop developing the relationship further. Jae-won finds out that her dad used the insurance proceeds to pay off her late mother’s gambling debt. Teo restores the recording of the night Jae-won was attacked and finds out who the perpetrator is.

4.o: Teo goes to confront the stalker who attacked Jae-won. But before Teo meets him, the stalker gets in an accident and becomes unconscious. Teo tries to find out who is behind the stalker, and Jae-won looks for Chi-young, Soon-young’s twin brother. She thinks that his existence is the only explanation for what has been happening to her lately. However, the investigation leads to another mystery.

5.o: Soon-young admits to dating Yoon-jin, and he asks for a divorce. He demands the custody of A-rin, but Jae-won refuses. Jae-won finds out that Yoon-jin has been picking A-rin up from her kindergarten from time to time. Yoon-jin’s portrait unveiling ceremony is held, and Jae-won prepares a special gift for her.

6.o: Jae-won decides to get a divorce, but she can’t give up the custody. However, Soon-young is most likely to take the custody because he spent more time with A-rin. To turn the table around, Jae-won frames Soon-young for leaking confidential documents. While doing so, Jae-won notices that she also has a critical weakness. Meanwhile, Teo continues to investigate and find out who tried to kill Baek Seung-kyu.

7.o: Soon-young recalls the day he got an email that revealed A-rin is not his biological daughter. After Jae-won realizes the reason behind Soon-young’s affair, she apologizes, but he doesn’t accept her apology. Jae-won decides to accept Soon-young’s terms and give up on A-rin.

8.o: Jae-won acts like a different person as if she had forgotten everything. Yoon-jin tries to make use of the situation, but Soon-young tells her to stay away from Jae-won. Soon-young takes Jae-won’s medicine pills to the doctor to find out what they are for. Meanwhile, Soon-young looks to find A-rin’s biological father with Teo's help, and Tae-ju meets Yoon-jin.

9.o: Jae-won’s father learns from Yoon-jin that Soon-young cheated on Jae-won. Outraged, he demands to know what Soon-young plans to do with Jae-won, and they both decide to keep Jae-won in the dark. Soon-young finds out who A-rin’s biological father is and what happened with Jae-won seven years ago.

10.o: Jae-won is accused of killing Soon-young and gets arrested. Circumstantial evidence points to Jae-won as the killer, but the police can’t find the crucial evidence to indict her. She gets freed for lack of evidence and goes to her father’s place to rest and avoid reporters. Meanwhile, Chairman Kwon called for a stockholders' meeting to dismiss Jae-won from the CEO position.

11.o: Jae-won and her father decide to send A-rin to America for her safety. Jae-won gets released from the mental institute and starts collecting evidence to prove who truly killed Soon-young. Meanwhile, Jae-won gets her hand on the data to prove that Kim Sang-bum manipulated the clinical test.

12.o: Jae-won is discharged, and she starts to put her plan into action. She visits Dereve and tells Yoon-jin that she will eventually get to her. Detective Oh Soo-jin looks into Soon-young’s case, and she notices that something is off. Jae-won goes to see Young-ik and tells him to choose the one that he wants to protect, his ministership or his daughter.

13.o: Kwon Young-ik tries to kill Jae-won with a pesticide, just like he did with Soon-young. Teo comes to the rescue, and Jae-won barely manages to survive. At the parliamentary inspection of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, Jae-won reveals that Kwon Young-ik is responsible for her kidnapping and Soon-young’s murder. Kwon Young-ik gets arrested, but Jae-won doesn’t feel like it’s over.

14.o: Yoon-jin finds Seung-kyu who has been hiding from her. She fails to persuade him to side with her, and she kills him without hesitation. She frames his murder to Tae-ju, and Tae-ju goes off the grid. Meanwhile, Jae-won tries to find people who know about her mother’s past.

15.o: Yoon-jin decides to get rid of Nam Tae-ju so he won’t be able to reveal the last card he has on her. However, her plan fails, and Nam Tae-ju appears in court to take the witness stand. Jae-won gets her hand on the video and tells Yoon-jin to come clean. When Yoon-jin refuses, Jae-won decides to use Nam Tae-ju to get her.

16.o: Yoon-jin takes A-rin, and everyone looks for them. Jae-won finds A-rin safe at home, and she asks her father to live with them together. A year later, Jae-won works as a freelance designer, and Teo becomes the CEO of Dereve. While doing so, Jae-won confronts her past and the resentment that has been following her to move on.

1.o: While writing a speech for an upcoming book launch, renowned surgeon and celebrated war hero, Dorrigo Evans is thrust back into memories of his time as a POW in WW2 and of his brief, yet unforgettable, love affair with Amy Mulvaney. A love which sustained him through this dark time.

2.o: We witness the burgeoning love affair between Dorrigo and Amy in the 1940s, which is in stark contrast to his present day marriage to his wife, Ella. The banality of his current life in the 1980s leads Dorrigo to take a risk that puts his surgical career in jeopardy.

3.o: Dorrigo has come under investigation for a risky procedure he performed, placing a further strain on his marriage. A marriage that is already feeling the effects of Dorrigo's everlasting love for Amy, a love both cannot resist. We also witness Dorrigo's deep love and care towards the soldiers when a cholera outbreak spreads through the POW camp, and his friend Rabbit becomes increasingly unwell.

4.o: Dorrigo and Amy's affair must end when Dorrigo is shipped off to war, where as a prisoner he bares witness to the most horrific of crimes.

5.o: Dorrigo returns from war and tries to get on with his life without Amy and many of his friends he lost to the POW camp. While in the present, the day of the book launch arrives and Dorrigo's reflections on his life come to a head.

7.o: At the mall, Kunagi and crew meet a cat that somehow understands human language and writing.

11.o: Wendelstein faces its biggest crisis yet as an army of cats mounted on animals of all types closes in.

12.o: Can Grandma's last resort save Wendelstein from certain doom at the hands (or paws) of the cat army?
